# GrabStack

> Signal, not noise — the living guide to AI tools, agents and stacks.

GrabStack is an independent, always-current field guide to AI tools, agents and stacks. Every entry carries a date and a review-by deadline. No affiliate links. Honest assessments.

## Sections

- The Wire (/wire): Fresh, dated field reports on what changed and why it matters.
- The Map (/map): The active frontier — cutting-edge tools, filterable by category and status.
- The List (/list): The full searchable catalogue of every tool we track.
- Routes (/routes): Curated tool stacks by job — combinations that work together.
- Terrain (/terrain): Types of AI access (chat → agent → autonomous) and a status glossary.
- The Capitals (/capitals): The dominant labs and flagship models.
- The Cemetery (/cemetery): Deprecated, shut-down, and acquired tools.
- The Cartographer (/cartographer): About, methodology, and update cadence.
